---
title: "Topic 6: Collaboration"
---

*Use at baseline and endline. Captures knowledge flows and partnerships — a key mechanism for innovation support instruments.*

**6.1 During the last three years, did your company cooperate with any other enterprises or organisations on innovation, technology, or business development activities?**
- Yes
- No


**6.2 What types of partners did your company cooperate with?**
*(Select all that apply)*
- Other enterprises within your group
- Suppliers of equipment, materials, or software
- Clients or customers
- Competitors or other firms in your sector
- Consultants or commercial laboratories
- Universities or other higher education institutions
- Public research institutes or technology centres
- Government agencies
- None

*Source: CIS. Use at: Baseline and endline.*

---

**6.3 Where were your most important cooperation partners located?**
*(Select all that apply)*
- Same region
- Same country (different region)
- Other EU countries
- Rest of the world

*Source: CIS. Use at: Baseline and endline.*

---

**6.4 How important were the following as sources of knowledge or information for your company's activities in the last three years?**
*Rate each: 1 = Not used, 2 = Low, 3 = Medium, 4 = High*
- Internal sources (within the firm or group)
- Suppliers
- Clients or customers
- Competitors
- Consultants or private R&D firms
- Universities or higher education institutions
- Public research institutes
- Professional conferences, trade fairs, or journals
- Technical standards, norms, or regulations
- Internet or online communities

*Source: CIS. Use at: Baseline and endline.*

---

**6.5 Did your company participate in any of the following in the last three years?**
*(Select all that apply)*
- An innovation cluster or competitiveness pole
- An industry or sectoral association
- A public-private partnership
- A joint venture or formal consortium
- None of the above

*Source: CIS / EuroComp-adapted. Use at: Baseline and endline.*

---

**6.6 What were the main barriers to collaboration your company faced in the last three years?**
*(Select all that apply)*
- Difficulty finding suitable partners
- Concerns about protecting intellectual property
- Lack of trust
- High coordination costs
- Geographical distance
- No barriers — we collaborated as much as we wanted
- We did not seek to collaborate

*Source: CIS / FAT. Use at: Baseline and endline.*
